title: Professional Growth in Agriculture
description: The design of this course is to enhance the educational and communication aspects of serving as a leader in agriculture. Class sessions revolve around effective interpersonal communication that influences personal growth development; leading group/team dynamics; and facilitating individual dynamics. Learners will consider current leadership issues within the agriculture industry, engage in communicating various leadership theories through workshop development and engagement. Altogether, the class will foster a teamwork through individual and group dynamics.
